## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run check` passes (typecheck, lint, format, tests).
- [ ] Behaviour changes have a test; security changes have a test showing what is now refused.
- [ ] Comments explain why, and the README, SECURITY.md and CHANGELOG still match the code.
- [ ] No new runtime dependencies, or the reason is explained above.
